title: U.S. adds up to $275M CHIPS grant for Micron

sources.quote: Today’s expanded investment of $200 billion is accompanied by up to $275 million in incremental CHIPS Act direct funding.

explain: When Micron raised its U.S. investment plan to $200 billion in June 2025, the Commerce Department added up to $275 million in grants on top of its December 2024 award, tied to Micron's Manassas, Virginia plant.
